scientific_integrity: All unrestricted conclusions have analytical proofs. A rational finite test is reported as a diagnostic only; no external scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The sharp boundary applies to stochastic kernels whose squares equal the uniform rank-one matrix. It does not classify all nonreversible kernels or all state spaces. Priority of the exact four-state construction versus older switched-product results is not independently established.
title: Four states are the minimum for switching failure among exact two-step mixers
